parameters.query: SELECT c.*, (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as last_activity_date, EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id)) as days_inactive FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('customer', 'lost') AND (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 're_engagement_sent' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ) ORDER BY c.lead_score DESC LIMIT 30

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, 're_engagement_sent', '{"template": "{{ $json.template_id }}", "urgency": "{{ $json.urgency }}", "days_inactive": {{ $json.days_inactive }}}', 0)

SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND la.activity_type IN ('email_opened', 'email_clicked', 'page_view') ) as re_engaged FROM contacts c WHERE c.id = {{ $json.id }}

UPDATE contacts SET lead_status = 'lost', lead_score = GREATEST(0, lead_score - 20) WHERE id = {{ $json.id }} AND (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = {{ $json.id }}) < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
